sections.Profile:
"Dragonfist" is a pinball machine released by Stern Electronics in November 1981. It features a martial arts theme with two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball. The machine is built on the Stern M-200 MPU system, with a total production of only 302 units, making it quite rare. Designed by Joe Joos Jr. with artwork by Doug Watson.
